title: Knowledge Graph Guided Evaluation of Abstention Techniques
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical mechanisms of how LLMs abstain from responding, using a benchmark called SELECT composed of benign concepts (e.g., 'rivers', 'people', 'creative works') to isolate the effects of safety training. It explicitly avoids sensitive, religious, or ethical topics in its benchmarking to provide a controlled study of the underlying abstention techniques' generalization and specificity.
